basis: Changed-files overlay on the supplied original repository plus Phase 1-4 updates; preserve all unlisted files.

localRegressionTests.command: node --test tests/launch/*.test.cjs tests/onboarding/*.test.cjs tests/interface/*.test.cjs tests/design/*.test.cjs tests/performance/*.test.cjs
localRegressionTests.method: Native Node test runner; actual TypeScript production modules transpiled using TypeScript with explicit dependency/I/O adapters, plus source/asset contracts. Backend response tests also use local Node HTTP.
localRegressionTests.limitation: Not a real Prisma/PostgreSQL/Redis/React integration run. TAP elapsed durations are test runtime, not application endpoint latency. Existing Phase 4 image hashes are checked; screenshots were not recaptured.

sourceValidation.limitation: Syntax transpilation and local import existence checks only, not dependency-complete type checking. Prisma-generated imports require regeneration.

dependencyCompleteTypecheck.reason: Pinned project dependencies are not installed; package-registry access was unavailable. Node type definitions and generated Prisma client were unavailable; tsc stopped at TS2688.

productionBuild.reason: Requires pinned project dependencies and, for backend, regenerated Prisma client.

stagingEndpointBudgets.reason: No authenticated staging API, exported request logs, representative database or isolated Redis fault environment was available.

realDatabaseMigrationAndExplainAnalyze.reason: No representative PostgreSQL deployment was available. Read-only preflight and explain tooling and a migration rollout procedure are included.

providerRegionsAndNetworkRoute.reason: No deployment-provider inventory/access was available. Topology annotations must be independently verified.

browserRequestLoopsAndTemplateParity.reason: No dependency-complete running Next application and authenticated staging browser were available.

bundleDeltaAndRouteChunkTransfers.reason: Requires comparable baseline/candidate production builds and real browser network observations.

realConcurrencyAndRedisOutage.reason: Local behavioral adapters do not replace multi-process database/cache staging tests.

securityAndCorrectness: Do not bypass authorization, weaken hashing, disable CSRF, change immediate revalidation to stale-while-revalidate, or claim readiness from a URL to achieve a latency target.
